    now = np.asarray(robot.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
    print("Connected; status:", robot.status(), flush=True)
    log_path = OUT / "run_log.json"
    if log_path.exists():
        try:
            runlog = json.loads(log_path.read_text())
        except Exception:
            runlog = {"completed_ranges": [], "chunks": []}
    else:
        runlog = {"completed_ranges": [], "chunks": []}
    runlog.setdefault("completed_ranges", []).append([start, stop])
    runlog["started_at_unix"] = runlog.get("started_at_unix", time.time())
    runlog["planned_strokes"] = len(strokes)
    runlog["contact_z_m"] = CONTACT_Z
    runlog["paper_z_m"] = PAPER_Z
    log_path.write_text(json.dumps(runlog, indent=2))

    last_color = None  # On a resumed range, explicitly reload its first color.
    total_steps = 0
    total_failures = 0
    for i in range(start, stop):
        color, u0, v0, u1, v1 = [int(x) for x in strokes[i]]
        sx, sy = pixel_to_world(u0, v0)
        ex, ey = pixel_to_world(u1, v1)
        rows: list[list[float]] = []
        if color != last_color:

            rows.append(pose(wx, wy, TRAVEL_Z))
            rows.append(pose(wx, wy, DIP_Z))
            rows.extend([pose(wx, wy, DIP_Z)] * 6)
            rows.append(pose(wx, wy, TRAVEL_Z))
        # Travel above the paper, lower and settle, make one continuous stroke, lift.
        rows.append(pose(sx, sy, TRAVEL_Z))
        rows.append(pose(sx, sy, CONTACT_Z))
        rows.extend([pose(sx, sy, CONTACT_Z)] * 8)
        rows.append(pose(ex, ey, CONTACT_Z))
        rows.append(pose(ex, ey, TRAVEL_Z))

        res = robot.submit(
            "ee_pose", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=0.05,
            cameras=[], video="none", note=f"main stroke {i + 1}/390, paint{color + 1:02d}",
        )
        step_count = int(res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk", 0))
        failures = sum(int(p.get("ik_failures", 0)) for p in res.meta.get("plan", []))
        total_steps += step_count
        total_failures += failures
        runlog["chunks"].append({
            "stroke": i + 1, "paint_id": color + 1, "control_steps": step_count,
            "ik_failures": failures, "plan": res.meta.get("plan", []),
        })
        runlog["last_completed_stroke"] = i + 1
        runlog["total_control_steps_this_run"] = total_steps
        runlog["ik_failures_this_run"] = total_failures
        log_path.write_text(json.dumps(runlog, indent=2))
        last_color = color
        if failures:
            print(f"WARNING: stroke {i + 1} reported {failures} IK failures", flush=True)
        if (i + 1) % 10 == 0 or i + 1 == stop:
            status = robot.status()
            print(f"stroke {i + 1}/{stop}: chunk={step_count} steps, total={total_steps}, "
                  f"IK failures={total_failures}, status={status}", flush=True)

    # Park clear of both overhead views; repeated target rows let the arm settle.
    park = pose(0.04, -0.30, 0.38)
    park_res = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray([park] * 7, dtype=np.float32), dt=0.05,
